relations.subject: Hara Tanzan
relations.evidence: At the age of 15, Hara enrolled at the Shoheizaka Academy (昌平坂学問所) where he studied both Confucianism and medicine

relations.subject: Hara Tanzan
relations.evidence: he studied both Confucianism and medicine, the latter under Taki Genken.

relations.subject: Hara Tanzan
relations.role: lecturer of Indian Philosophy and Buddhist Studies
relations.evidence: Hara became the first lecturer of Indian Philosophy and Buddhist Studies at Tokyo Imperial University in 1879.

relations.subject: Hara Tanzan
relations.evidence: He was later superintendent of the Soto-shu Daigaku-rin (currently Komazawa University).
